findings.title: Approved publishing fails in production
findings.evidence: GitHub run 38014416374 fails at sync-publications.mjs:9 with HTTP 403. Live publication requests: pageSize=100 returns 200; pageSize=1000 returns 403. Public rules cap queries at 100.
findings.fix: Use bounded pagination consistent with rules and test the real publishing workflow.

findings.title: Withdrawn publications remain publicly readable
findings.evidence: Isolated emulator reproduces successful anonymous get of a publication with state=withdrawn. firestore.rules:55 allows all gets.
findings.fix: Separate internal withdrawal records from public output or require published state for public reads; update queries and publishing/withdrawal handling together.

findings.title: New approved articles bypass the reader and discovery catalogs
findings.evidence: Full isolated publication fixture builds successfully, but generated article lacks readingIssue/article-tools/edition-reader and is absent from edition-reader.json. Article text index remains 686 after adding a new article.
findings.fix: Generate the same article template and rebuild issue/reader/discovery catalogs from approved publications; add an integration regression test.
